alert:
PAGE [SEV2] ShopStack synthetic monitoring is failing.
Probe success 80%, p95 692ms over the last few seconds.
  - GET /api/health: 2/2 failed, statuses [200] ({"checks":{"cache":"error: Error -2 connecting to redis:6379. Name does not reso)
Investigate, restore service, verify recovery, then submit an incident report.

root_causes.evidence: redis is not attached to the backend network it belongs on (list_services); 42 name-resolution errors in logs, e.g. probe /api/health: {"checks":{"cache":"error: Error -2 connecting to redis:6379. Name does not resolve.","database":"ok

report.summary: [confirmed] re-attach redis to the backend network (restores its DNS name) (confidence 0.94; evidence: redis is not attached to the backend network it belongs on (list_services)). Prevent: monitor container network attachment and DNS resolution between services.
